lines.say: Your app gets popular, and your database, where all your data lives, can't keep up. But look at what it's doing. Most of it is reading.
lines.show: Your app gets *popular,* and your database, where all your data lives, [can't keep up.] But look at what it's doing. Most of it is *reading.*

lines.say: Loading a feed, opening a profile, searching. Those read data. Posting writes new data. Most apps read far more than they write.
lines.show: Loading a feed, opening a profile, searching. Those *read* data. Posting *writes* new data. Most apps [read far more] than they write.

lines.say: So you add read replicas: copies of your database that get every change from the main one, called the primary.
lines.show: So you add [read replicas:] copies of your database that get every *change* from the main one, called the [primary.]

lines.say: Every write still goes to the primary. It sends each change onto the copies.
lines.show: Every *write* still goes to the [primary.] It sends each change onto the *copies.*

lines.say: Reads are spread across the copies. Need more reads? Add another copy.
lines.show: Reads are *spread* across the copies. Need more reads? [Add another copy.]

lines.say: The catch: copying takes a moment, so a replica can be a little behind. That's called replication lag.
lines.show: The catch: copying takes a moment, so a replica can be a little *behind.* That's called [replication lag.]

lines.say: You post a comment, refresh, and the copy you read from doesn't have it yet. The fix: right after someone writes, read their own data from the primary for a few seconds.
lines.show: You post a comment, refresh, and the copy you read from [doesn't have it yet.] The fix: right after someone *writes,* read their own data from the [primary] for a few seconds.

lines.say: Like students copying a teacher's board. You ask a student, from their notes, so the teacher keeps writing. But a student might be a line behind.
lines.show: Like students copying a [teacher's board.] You ask a student, from their *notes,* so the teacher keeps *writing.* But a student might be a [line behind.]

lines.say: Replicas help with reads, not writes. Every write still lands on that one primary.
lines.show: Replicas help with *reads,* not writes. Every write still lands on that [one primary.]
